subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat's unresumable restart-recovery notice be persisted as a synthetic `delivery-mirror` transcript row?
rationale: The implementation is a narrow fix, but it defines durable session-history behavior for failed WebChat recovery rather than only transient delivery.

options.title: Accept Transcript Notice Contract
options.body: Keep the current product shape and require the branch to be refreshed against current main before merge.

options.title: Require UI Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short WebChat restart/reconnect capture before accepting the persistent transcript-row behavior.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or recover-and-confirm to own this UX instead.

recommendation.title: Accept Transcript Notice Contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current product shape and require the branch to be refreshed against current main before merge.
